recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 623: May 7, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly Issue 623 covers several notable updates in the Node.js ecosystem. Node.js 26.1 ships an experimental `node:ffi` module, enabling direct interfacing with native C libraries without writing glue code — a long-awaited core FFI solution. Node 20 (Iron) has reached End-of-Life, meaning all active LTS releases now support TypeScript via type stripping without flags. Rolldown 1.0, a high-performance JS bundler with esbuild-like speed and Rollup plugin compatibility, has reached stable. PM2 7.0 drops many external dependencies and improves Bun runtime support. Electron 42 changes its binary download behavior to mitigate supply chain attack risks. Building Node 26+ from source now requires a Rust toolchain due to the Temporal API's Rust-based implementation.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 622: April 30, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly Issue 622 covers several notable releases in the Node.js ecosystem. pnpm 11.0 ships with a SQLite-backed package index, native publishing tooling, isolated global installs, and supply-chain protection on by default. Fresh 2.3, Deno's full-stack framework, adds first-class WebSocket support, zero-JS shipping for static pages, and View Transitions API support. AVA 8.0 is now fully ESM with new conditional test modifiers. Other releases include Hono Node.js Adapter 2.0 with performance improvements, Mongoose 9.6, and several smaller library updates.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 621: April 23, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly issue 621 highlights several topics including writing Node.js addons with .NET Native AOT (allowing C# code to expose N-API entry points), building a hexagonal SVG world map with a Node pipeline, and a spotlight on Playwright v1.59.0's new page.screencast API. The screencast API enables granular video recording start/stop, visual chapter annotations, custom HTML overlays, and a new playwright-cli show dashboard for inspecting running browsers — making it easy to auto-generate polished documentation videos.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 619: April 9, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly Issue 619 covers several notable topics: social engineering attacks targeting high-impact Node.js maintainers and npm package owners, a technique for halting async functions by awaiting a never-resolving promise (used in production by Inngest), and the pause of Node.js's security bug bounty program due to loss of funding from the Internet Bug Bounty program. The issue also rounds up a batch of releases including ky 2.0, ESLint 10.2, Ink 7.0, Axios 1.8.0, Undici 8.0, pnpm v11.0 Beta 8, and several others.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 617: March 26, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly issue 617 covers TypeScript 6.0's release with a focused breakdown of breaking changes for Node developers: types now defaults to empty array, strict mode is on by default, --moduleResolution node is deprecated in favor of nodenext, module defaults to esnext, and esModuleInterop/allowSyntheticDefaultImports flags are removed. Other highlights include pnpm 11 Beta with a SQLite-powered store and stricter build security, Deno employee departures amid company hardship, a Fastify protocol/host spoofing vulnerability fixed in v5.8.3+, a deep dive into Node WebSocket pod memory bloat, an article on reducing node_modules size, and a Knex.js revival announcement. Release notes also cover Deno 2.7.6-2.7.8, pnpm 10.33, Faker 10.4, ws 8.20.0, and OpenAI Node v6.33.0.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 620: April 16, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly issue 620 covers the release of Node.js 24.15.0 LTS with stable require(esm), module compile cache, --max-heap-size, and OpenSSL 4.0 build support. Also featured: the OWASP NPM Security Best Practices Cheat Sheet with updates on typosquatting and dependency confusion, a C-to-WebAssembly-to-Node pipeline guide, and lessons from building a Rust runtime for TypeScript. Notable releases include Jazzer.js 4.0 (ESM fuzzer), Chartbrew 5.0, Happy DOM 20.9, and node-mssql 12.3. Ecosystem news includes FluidCAD for parametric CAD in JS, a cautionary tale about AWS Lambda connection reuse with MySQL causing InnoDB freezes, and GitHub's private preview of Stacked PRs.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 618: April 2, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly Issue 618 covers several topics in the Node.js ecosystem: a guide to using 'minimum release age' cooldowns with npm, pnpm, Bun, and Yarn to mitigate supply chain attacks; an introduction to npm workspaces for managing multiple packages in a monorepo; Deno v2.7.11 release with Node.js compatibility improvements for crypto, child_process, workers, and TTY handling; QuickBEAM, a JavaScript runtime for Erlang's BEAM VM with Node.js API compatibility; WWWBasic 1.0.2 adding ESM support for running BASIC in Node apps; and wasm-git, a WASM-compiled Git usable from Node.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 616: March 19, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly issue 616 covers several topics: a Reddit discussion on AI-generated large PRs in the Node.js community, a Frontend Masters course on building AI agents from scratch in Node.js, the controversial node:vfs PR, and a practical case study on using worker threads to solve event loop starvation in a WebSocket-based SDK.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 615: March 12, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly Issue 615 covers several notable releases and tools in the Node.js ecosystem. ArkType 2.2 introduces runtime-validated functions via type.fn, allowing TypeScript types to double as runtime validators. MikroORM 7 ('unchained') drops Knex in favor of Kysely, removes core dependencies, decouples from Node, adds a type-safe query builder, CTE support, and ships as a native ESM package. Also noted: better-sqlite3 12.7 release and a TimescaleDB promotion for analytics on Node apps.

recent_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 613: February 26, 2026
recent_posts.summary: Node Weekly issue 613 covers path traversal attack prevention in Node.js, structured concurrency in JavaScript via Effection, publishing to npm from GitHub Actions using OIDC trusted publishing, and Git configuration files. Release highlights include Emscripten 5.0.2, Hono 4.12, BullMQ v5.70, Orange ORM 5.2, and ESLint 10.0.2. Sponsored content features Clerk's credential stuffing protection and an HTML-to-PDF API.

top_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 610: February 5, 2026
top_posts.summary: This newsletter covers explicit resource management in JavaScript using the `using` keyword for deterministic cleanup, a postmortem of JSBin's 3-day outage caused by traffic spikes on an outdated Node 7 runtime, and highlights libraries for one-time password authentication (HOTP/TOTP) and simplified FFmpeg video operations. Also includes updates to the 'ora' terminal spinner library and Node bindings for FFmpeg's C APIs.

top_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 569: March 11, 2025
top_posts.summary: Node Weekly Issue 569 covers numerous tools and insights on Node.js and JavaScript development. Highlights include Node Modules Inspector for analyzing package dependencies, ThePrimeagen’s advice on crafting a development setup with bash scripts, and various interesting reads like best practices for file uploads and how Kubernetes interacts with Node.js. Additionally, don't miss the quick roundup on JavaScript trends and resources, including the latest from HTTP Archive and end-of-life dates for popular open source projects.

top_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 570: March 18, 2025
top_posts.summary: Node v23.10.0 introduces the --experimental-config-file option for JSON-based configuration of command line options, simplifying the setup for tasks like configuring the test runner. Node v20.19.0, still in LTS, gains default support for require(esm), facilitating the use of native ES modules. Héctor Molinero Fernández presents the OTPAuth library for managing HOTP and TOTP in JavaScript, while the Node & Conquer Conference scheduled for April 4, 2025 in Paris will focus on running Node.js at scale.

top_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 609: January 29, 2026
top_posts.summary: Node.js 25.5 simplifies single executable application building with a new --build-sea flag that eliminates external tooling. The newsletter covers performance benchmarks across Node versions 16-25, security advisories for OpenSSL vulnerabilities, and community discussions about framework choices. Additional topics include Redis client benchmarking, GitHub Actions improvements, and serverless platform cold start comparisons.

top_posts.title: Node Weekly Issue 611: February 12, 2026
top_posts.summary: TypeScript 6.0 beta focuses on tsconfig cleanup as a bridge to the Go-powered TypeScript 7 compiler. The newsletter covers HTTP requests in Node.js using fetch, Undici, and native modules, plus updates to Transformers.js v4 with WebGPU support, Ink 6.7 for terminal apps with concurrent rendering, VineJS 4.3 for form validation with JSON Schema support, and Prisma 7.4.0 with new caching. Also featured: almostnode for running Node in browsers, webpack's 2026 roadmap, and various ecosystem updates.
